style: Painterly realistic digital painting, five years after nuclear war in Australia; muted earth palette, amber light, teal shadows. Landscape 16:9, no text or UI.

prompts.works-message: A lantern-lit shelter table with an old handwritten ledger, sealed warning envelope and two water canisters, a doorway opening toward ruined east-side houses. No readable writing.
prompts.works-road: A lone anonymous courier seen from behind at a fork between a ruined residential street and a distant bridge, carrying a canvas satchel, threatening grey figures far away.
prompts.works-warning: At dawn a small group of anonymous civilians quietly leave damaged east-side homes with modest bundles along a sheltered back path; bittersweet evacuation, intact people, no battle.
prompts.works-relief: Anonymous east-side residents repairing a communal pump beside delivered water canisters and tools, wary but hopeful, ruined homes behind them.
prompts.kell: An elderly short sturdy woman with short cropped white hair, sharp blue eyes, reading glasses on a cord, checked shirt and navy fleece vest distributes water at a rough bridge exchange, serious humane expression.
prompts.repairers: An independent workshop cooperative, anonymous mechanics in worn work clothes rebuilding filter cartridges under an amber lamp, spare copper tubing and hand tools, practical mutual work.
prompts.hounds: A threatening recruiter in a grey dyed hooded coat, dull grey half face respirator, yellow plastic freight tag on shoulder, face obscured, at a freight checkpoint with confiscated civilian crates. No dogs.
prompts.travellers: Two tired anonymous adult travellers with canvas packs outside a heavy shelter entrance, empty water flask held out, restrained humane scene.
prompts.breakdown: A broken portable water pump and a leaking pipe in a ruined concrete service yard, an anonymous mechanic kneeling nearby, tools and rusted parts.
prompts.checkpoint: A ruined road checkpoint with a makeshift boom gate, faceless grey hooded Ash Hound guards wearing respirators and yellow shoulder freight tags, civilian supply cart stopped.
prompts.cache: A half-open supply locker in an abandoned tunnel, sealed tins, canvas sack and salvage components, a painted unlettered ownership mark, warm flashlight and cold shadows.
prompts.works-valve: An underground waterworks gallery, iron valve chained shut with a yellow freight tag, damp concrete, abandoned navy toolbag, warm flashlight in cold teal darkness. Environmental storytelling, no people, no readable text, no UI, no collage.

ruth_revision: Edited against docs/narrative/visual-bible/ruth.webp, right-hand figure: preserve identity, cropped straight grey-white hair, black reading glasses on her face, checked shirt and navy vest; then remove duplicate glasses hanging on chest.
